message:
Show the demo as a GIF in the README

GitHub does not render <video> tags that point at files in the repo, so embed a GIF
and link the MP4 for full quality.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add a demo video to the README

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix layout shift in the player cards

The "What the model reads" box has a fixed four-line height, and the card title,
harness description, status line and stat values no longer change the card height.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fit the whole game in one screen

Player cards now sit beside the court with the selector inside each card, and the
court is sized from the viewport height, so no scrolling is needed on a normal
window. Below 900x560 it falls back to a stacked, scrollable layout.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Run the model on the GPU when available

The server now takes --device (default auto: cuda, then mps, then cpu) and
warms the model up at startup. arena.py gets --device too but stays on the CPU
by default so logged results remain reproducible. On Apple MPS a decision takes
about 90 ms instead of 160 ms.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add GLiNER Pong: browser game, server and headless arena

- pong.html: pick the left and right player, each either "You" or an AI harness
  (You vs AI, or AI vs AI), with a card per AI showing what the model reads and decides
- pong_server.py: side-aware /decide, input validation, /health, --host/--port
- arena.py, players/, results/, REPORT.md: headless ladder that ranks harnesses
- README with setup, how to play, how to add a harness

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
